description: Applied for both Sales Invoice and POS Invoice
label: Create Invoice without Tax
name: Branch-custom_no_taxes

description: QZ Tray websocket host. Almost always 'localhost' — QZ Tray runs on the cashier's machine and the browser connects to it over localhost. Only change this if QZ Tray is running on a different host on the same LAN (rare).
label: QZ Host
name: POS Profile-qz_host

description: This role grants permissions for Captain Transfer with access to all tables
label: Role Permitted For Captain Transfer
name: POS Profile-transfer_role_permissions

description: Users assigned this role will function as cashiers in URY POS, responsible for managing billing transactions.
label: Role Allowed For Billing
name: POS Profile-role_allowed_for_billing

description: Set a limit for the cashier to view a restricted number of recently paid invoices.
label: Show Limited Paid Invoices
name: POS Profile-paid_limit

description: Users with this role have restricted access to table order functions.
label: Role Restricted For Table Order
name: POS Profile-role_restricted_for_table_order

label: Order Type
name: POS Invoice-order_type
options:
Dine In
Phone In
Take Away
Delivery
Aggregators

description: Enables Cashiers to view all statuses (Paid, Consolidated, Return Invoices) in the recent order.
label: Allow Cashier To View All Status
name: POS Profile-view_all_status

label: Allow Cashier To Edit And Remove Table Order Items
name: POS Profile-remove_items

label: Show Item Image In URY Pos
name: POS Profile-show_image

description: Validate that the previous day’s POS is closed before opening a new one.
label: Require Daily POS Closing
name: POS Profile-custom_daily_pos_close

description: How to gate POS Opening Entry creation. "Disabled" falls back to the legacy Shift Length (Hours) reminder. "URY Shift" uses URY Shift Assignment + URY Shift records to enforce a per-user start/end window. "HRMS Shift Type" uses ERPNext HRMS Shift Type + Shift Assignment via the Employee linked to the user (requires hrms app installed).
label: Shift System Mode
name: POS Profile-custom_shift_system_mode
options:
Disabled
URY Shift
HRMS Shift Type

description: Legacy mode only. Length of a single shift in hours. After this many hours have elapsed since the POS Opening Entry was created, the React POS shows a banner reminding the cashier to close the shift. Set to 0 to disable shift-hour reminders entirely. Hidden when Shift System Mode is set to URY Shift or HRMS Shift Type — use the assigned shift instead.
label: Shift Length (Hours)
name: POS Profile-custom_shift_hours

description: When the shift length is exceeded, also block new orders until the cashier closes the shift. With this off, the banner is just a soft reminder — the cashier can keep ringing orders past their shift.
label: Block Orders After Shift End
name: POS Profile-custom_block_orders_after_shift_end

description: When checked, only URY Captain / URY Manager / Administrator users can merge orders on this terminal. When unchecked, cashiers can merge their own orders too. The captain's privilege of merging across cashiers is preserved either way.
label: Restrict Merge Orders to Captain
name: POS Profile-custom_restrict_merge_to_captain

description: When checked, every stock-tracked item on this profile's restaurant menus is allowed to go negative on stock. Saving the profile walks all menus tied to the restaurant and flips Item.allow_negative_stock on each Item master. Unchecking reverses the flip on the same items. Note: this is a per-Item flag on the Item master, so two POS Profiles sharing the same item will fight (last save wins).
label: Allow Negative Stock on Menu Items
name: POS Profile-custom_allow_negative_stock_on_menu_items

description: When checked (default), only URY Captain / URY Manager / Administrator users can issue returns from the Orders page right panel. When unchecked, cashiers can return their own orders too. The captain's privilege of returning any cashier's order is preserved either way.
label: Restrict Returns to Captain
name: POS Profile-custom_restrict_returns_to_captain

description: Master switch. When off, no location check is performed on login and the React POS never requests geolocation permission. When on, users whose current GPS position is outside the allowed radius (per-user coordinates or the company coordinates below) are blocked from opening the POS.
label: Enable Geofence
name: POS Profile-custom_geofence_enabled

description: Company latitude. Use the "Get Current Location" button to capture this device's current GPS position.
label: Company Latitude
name: POS Profile-custom_company_latitude

description: Company longitude. Use the "Get Current Location" button to capture this device's current GPS position.
label: Company Longitude
name: POS Profile-custom_company_longitude

description: Default allowed distance (in meters) from the company or per-user coordinates. A user can override this per-user in the Branch's ExPOS Users table. 200m is a generous default that covers most restaurant footprints plus a bit of parking lot.
label: Geofence Radius (m)
name: POS Profile-custom_geofence_radius_meters

description: When checked, cashiers can unmerge tables even after placing new orders on the merged master. At unmerge time the UI asks the cashier to assign each post-merge order to a destination table. When unchecked (default), the unmerge is blocked as soon as the merged master has a new order on it — the cashier has to pay / cancel the new orders first.
label: Allow Table Unmerge After New Orders
name: POS Profile-custom_allow_unmerge_after_new_orders

description: When checked, cashiers can charge an order to a hotel guest's room via the iHotel integration instead of taking cash/card. Requires a default Charge Type below.
label: Enable iHotel Integration
name: POS Profile-custom_ihotel_enabled

description: Default Charge Type used when a cashier charges a POS order to a hotel room. Written onto the iHotel Profile's folio charge row.
label: iHotel Charge Type
name: POS Profile-custom_ihotel_charge_type

description: Enable discount feature in URY POS
label: Enable Discount
name: POS Profile-custom_enable_discount

label: Order Type
name: Sales Invoice-order_type
options:
Dine In
Take Away
Delivery
Phone In
Aggregators

description: Physical terminal (till) that rang this invoice. Stamped automatically from the React POS session.
label: Terminal
name: POS Invoice-custom_terminal

description: Set when this invoice has been merged into another (the master). Hidden from the Orders page list. Cleared on unmerge.
label: Merged Into
name: POS Invoice-custom_merged_into

description: Set when this invoice has been charged to a hotel guest's room via the iHotel integration. Charged-room invoices stay docstatus=0 (never consolidated) — the actual GL posting happens when iHotel checks the guest out.
label: Charged to Hotel Room
name: POS Invoice-custom_charge_to_room

description: Hotel room (from the iHotel app) this invoice is charged against.
label: Hotel Room
name: POS Invoice-custom_hotel_room

description: iHotel Profile the folio charge row was written against. Populated automatically on 'Charge to Room'.
label: iHotel Profile
name: POS Invoice-custom_ihotel_profile

description: Physical terminal (till) this opening entry belongs to. Stamped automatically from the React POS session. Two terminals on the same branch each get their own opening entry.
label: Terminal
name: POS Opening Entry-custom_terminal

description: Frappe naming-series pattern for auto-generated KOT docs. Default is 'KOT-.YYYY.-.####' which produces KOT-2026-0001, KOT-2026-0002, etc. Leave blank only if you have a specific reason to disable KOT auto-creation on this profile (the backend throws 'KOT Naming Series is mandatory' when blank).
label: URY KOT Naming Series
name: POS Profile-kot_naming_series

description: New (2026-04-16) unified print configuration. Replaces the legacy printer_settings child table, custom_table_order_printer, custom_parcel_order_printer fields. The backend reads these first and falls back to the legacy fields when empty. See CLAUDE.md "Fixes log" 2026-04-16.
label: Printers & Routing
name: POS Profile-custom_print_routing_section

description: How the POS reaches its printers. QZ Tray (default for cloud-hosted Frappe, prints via the browser). CUPS Direct (server-side printing via CUPS — only works when the Frappe server can reach the printers). Disabled (no printing).
label: Print Mode
name: POS Profile-custom_print_mode

description: The printer that prints the receipt/bill. Required when Print Mode is not Disabled.
label: Bill Printer
name: POS Profile-custom_bill_printer

description: The printer in the kitchen (food KOT target). Leave blank to fall back to the Bill printer.
label: Kitchen KOT Printer
name: POS Profile-custom_kitchen_kot_printer

description: The printer at the bar (drinks KOT target). Leave blank to fall back to Kitchen, then to Bill.
label: Bar KOT Printer
name: POS Profile-custom_bar_kot_printer

description: The printer for parcel/takeaway KOTs. Leave blank to fall back to Kitchen.
label: Parcel KOT Printer
name: POS Profile-custom_parcel_kot_printer

description: Where drinks-department KOTs should print. Drinks items are detected via their URY Menu Course's Department field. Defaults to Bar.
label: Drinks KOT Route
name: POS Profile-custom_drinks_kot_route

description: Where food-department KOTs should print. Food items are detected via their URY Menu Course's Department field. Defaults to Kitchen.
label: Food KOT Route
name: POS Profile-custom_food_kot_route

description: Where parcel/takeaway KOTs should print. If Parcel is selected and the Parcel KOT Printer is empty, falls back to Kitchen.
label: Takeaway KOT Route
name: POS Profile-custom_takeaway_kot_route

description: What to do when a KOT's target printer is offline. Fallback to Bill: route to the bill printer with a "<department> - <target> OFFLINE" header so the kitchen/bar knows to intercept. Fail Silently: swallow the error. Fail with Alert: show a loud toast so the cashier can retry.
label: Print Fallback Mode
name: POS Profile-custom_print_fallback_mode
options:
Fallback to Bill Printer
Fail Silently
Fail with Alert

description: Classifies this menu course as Food, Drinks, or Other. Drives KOT routing (drinks → Bar printer, food → Kitchen printer, etc) in the new Printers & Routing config on POS Profile.
label: Department
name: URY Menu Course-custom_department
